integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 62 file changes, 43 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: The better scene and by far the better-verified run, with foreground parallax, water reflection and a ground-hugging smoke ring. It trades away the one thing the brief singles out: the rocket itself is small in frame.

standards.summary: 1,990 lines with a shaped particle system and depth-sorted foreground layers. Forty-three verification actions across the run, the highest of any single-file task here.

findings.title: Raw Math.random throughout the particle system
findings.detail: Fifteen call sites use Math.random directly, so no two loops are alike and a visual regression cannot be reproduced from a screenshot. The sibling run's seeded generator costs two lines and makes the loop diffable.

strengths: Multiple particle shape families give the smoke visible internal structure
Foreground palm silhouettes render on their own layer for real parallax depth
43 verification actions: the animation was checked repeatedly rather than once
Water reflection and horizon sun computed rather than painted

specification.summary: The scene, sequence and effects are all delivered, but the brief states the rocket should be the visual centrepiece and here the scenery wins that competition.

findings.title: Rocket is undersized relative to the brief's emphasis
findings.detail: The brief says the rocket should be the visual centrepiece and to spend time on its geometry. At the default framing the rocket is roughly a third the height of the sibling run's, so panel lines, hatch and nozzle detail are below the resolution the viewer can see. Scale the rocket up or bring the camera in for the pre-launch phase.

strengths: All four animation phases with the requested easing contrast between launch and return
Stars, clouds, ocean waves, island, palms and launch tower all present
Heat haze and ember sparks implemented rather than skipped
Model name in both the document title and the page

ux.summary: A more atmospheric composition with real depth layering. The dark palette pushes the horizon glow forward and the ground smoke reads convincingly across the island.

findings.title: Animation cannot be paused or reduced
findings.detail: No prefers-reduced-motion handling for a continuously animating fullscreen canvas. Offer a static frame when the user has asked for reduced motion.

strengths: Foreground/midground/background separation gives the frame real depth
Ground smoke spreads across the island and over the water as specified
Sun reflection on the water anchors the horizon
Restrained title placement keeps the scene uncluttered
